intro: This report provides a comprehensive and up-to-date overview of the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) product migration to the Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem (CDSE). It details the ingestion status of the extensive CLMS product portfolio, categorising products by global, Pan-European, and priority area. The document now also summarises product groups by their migration completeness, highlighting those fully available and those not yet ingested across key CDSE data access services, including S3, OData, STAC, OpenEO, and Sentinel Hub. This weekly updated report is essential for monitoring CLMS data accessibility and dissemination progress.
